$description: THE ONE HOME for polarities (s238-D1): a polarity is a node with N typed parties, each resolving to a principle, an obligation, a ruling (knowledge/_rulings.json) or a declared stub (stubs.json), and typed out-links to rulings (s238-D6: resolvedBy / explainedBy / challengedBy / touches). It carries NO status (s238-D3: derived at build time into _generated/polarity-status.json) and NO judgement text (s238-D7 refusal 3: its only judgement is a typed link). Pairwise edges are DERIVED into _generated/polarity-edges.json, never authored. Schema: schema/polarity.schema.json. Writer: knowledge/_validate_polarities.py --add-polarity (textual, reconstruction-proven). 'tension' was renamed 'polarity' before generation (s238-D4); ids tn-NN -> pl-NN, the R1 id kept under sources[].id.

polarities.mediating_variable: LAYER: convention governs MECHANISM (where things are, how they behave), distinctiveness governs SIGNAL (which single element carries the moment). Also brand mandate.

links.quote: The law IS a Von Restorff budget with a legal contrast floor attached.

polarities.mediating_variable: WHO ABSORBS IT: user expertise and task frequency. Also whether the removed complexity is REGULATED (then it cannot be relocated off-screen at all).

polarities.mediating_variable: TASK CRITICALITY and whether the user believes work is being done on their behalf. Search and underwriting benefit from visible work; a toggle does not.
WHO IS MEASURING: in evaluation, aesthetics is a confound to control; in shipping, it is a benefit to bank.

parties.note: be liberal in what you accept

polarities.mediating_variable: LAYER AGAIN: tolerant at the INPUT SURFACE (normalise the phone number), strict at the BOUNDARY (validate before persisting or transmitting).

parties.note: the peak and the ending dominate memory

polarities.mediating_variable: MEASUREMENT WINDOW: remembered satisfaction (peak-end wins) vs in-task completion and error rate (consistency wins).
DEVICE and POINTER TYPE, plus whether the target is a CONTROL (44/48) or a DATA MARK (24).

polarities.mediating_variable: INTERRUPTION COST vs INFORMATION VALUE: how reversible is the thing the user is doing, and how time-critical is the news.

links.quote: the shell exists; the ROUTING RULE does not

polarities.mediating_variable: WHOSE INTEREST: goal-gradient helps a user finish a task they chose; the artificial-progress variant serves the business.
TIMING: guidance attached to the moment of need beats guidance attached to first launch. Also frequency of use.
REGULATORY CONTEXT and consequence asymmetry. In a bank, a rare case can be the expensive one.

polarities.mediating_variable: WHETHER THE REMOVED THING WAS REAL: was an option deleted, or moved out of sight?
PREFERENCE CLARITY and EXPERTISE — the moderators Scheibehenne et al. identified. Novices with unclear preferences benefit from curation; experts do not.
NEITHER APPLIES: both are recall-capacity claims and a visible menu is a recognition task.

exempt marks explicitly with a named check (s116-D1)

polarities.mediating_variable: FREQUENCY OF USE per element, and whether recall would be from the same screen or from elsewhere.
TRUTH and REVERSIBILITY: a real count shown honestly is persuasion; a fabricated or non-reversible one is prohibited design.
REGULATORY CONTEXT plus DECISION MOMENT. Disclosure must be present AT the decision, not one click away in a PDF.
AUDIENCE PURPOSE: decision-support (accuracy wins) vs communication to a general audience (engagement can win, with the accuracy loss declared).
STRENGTH ORDER: common region beats proximity when they conflict. So a keyline in the wrong place silently redefines the group.

links.quote: keyline HUGS the module rather than sitting centred in the gutter, which resolves this precisely

polarities.mediating_variable: ACTION CONSEQUENCE: acknowledgement is always immediate; CELEBRATION is proportional.
COST OF THE SECOND ROUTE: does it change the mental model, or just the entry point?
CONSENT vs CONVENIENCE and REVERSIBILITY. A default on a data-protection choice is unlawful; a default on units or theme is a kindness.
LOAD TYPE: extraneous load (remove freely) vs germane/intrinsic state the task needs held (must stay visible).
MECHANICAL vs INFERENTIAL: mechanical checks (contrast, target size, semantics) are reliable; judgement checks are not.

links.quote: Dave already leans this way: 'mechanical over inference' (s234-D6)

polarities.mediating_variable: WHETHER THE PAGE HAS STRUCTURE: the F appears when structure is absent. It is a symptom, not a target.
LEGAL FLOOR plus INPUT MODALITY. Keyboard users are not a subset that can be styled away.
